name: Vida AI
task: AI voice agents that answer for you
summary: Deploy autonomous frontline voice agents. Let AI answer calls, book appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7 without sounding robotic.
best_for: agencies, MSPs and service providers that want to deploy and resell white-label AI voice agents at volume, and that can absorb a scoped pilot before they ever see a production price
skip_if: you're one business wanting one AI receptionist and need a published monthly price to compare (Vida quotes everything after a pilot starting at $1,500), or your call flows are too high-stakes to automate yet
honest_knock: This is priced for agencies and telecoms reselling AI phone agents, not for a single small business wanting one receptionist bot. Every deployment starts with a scoped pilot from $1,500, credited toward your first month, and the production price arrives as a quote afterwards — so you cannot compare it on price until you have spent money finding out. And the universal truth of voice AI: demo calls are rehearsed, your callers aren't. Pilot it on your real call types (accents, interruptions, edge requests) and measure containment rate before betting the front desk on it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pilot · a one-off scoped pilot, credited toward the first month in production
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-10) Vida publishes no public pricing: no plan ladder, no monthly tier and no per-minute rate. Every deployment starts with a scoped pilot from $1,500, credited toward your first month in production, and the production price arrives as a quote afterwards. Its pricing page sells that process — a discovery call of twenty to thirty minutes, scoping and a proof of concept in one to two business days that you sign off before anything is built, an agent build and live pilot in two to ten business days, then production — while the feature table beneath it lists agent, reseller, support and compliance capabilities with no price attached to any of them. All plans are subject to fair use, and the page warns that SMS campaign registration may take up to two weeks. Read 10 September 2026 across vida.io/pricing, /partners, /affiliates, /platform, /features and /faq, all reached from the site's own sitemap: that pilot figure is the only customer-facing number on the site, and the commission tiers on /affiliates are what a reseller earns rather than what a buyer pays. Correction to our own earlier dossier: an agency ladder of about $750 a month for 5 agents and roughly 2,500 AI voice minutes, plus platform plans from about $2,500 and the per-minute rate we derived from them, appear nowhere on vida.io.

compare_with.why: builder-oriented voice-AI platforms — Vida's edge is the reseller/white-label model; compare per-minute economics at your projected volume
